map.粪便处理量估算器 使用指南: Manure Handling Volume Estimator User Guide
map.输入畜禽种类、存栏数量与饲养周期，估算每日及全期粪便产生量、干物质量，并推算储粪: Enter livestock type, herd size and rearing cycle to estimate daily and whole-cycle manure production and dry matter, and derive the storage capacity needed, for manure handling planning.
map.由头数与日排泄量估粪污总量与干物质。: Estimate total manure and dry matter from head count and daily excretion.
map.清粪与存储设计输入。: Inputs for manure cleaning and storage design.
map.：日排泄 2kg/头 → 日 200kg、30 天 6 吨；收集 90% 得 5: : excretion 2 kg per head per day -> 200 kg/day, 30 days is 6 tonnes; collecting 90% gives 5.4 tonnes, at 80% water that is 1.08 tonnes dry matter; volume ≈ 5.6 m³.
map.：干物质 1.08 吨（N5%）：含 N 约 54 kg 当量。: : dry matter 1.08 tonnes (N 5%): contains about 54 kg nitrogen equivalent.
map.猪约 2、牛约 20~30、禽约 0.1~0.15 kg/头·天，随体重饲料变。: Pigs about 2, cattle about 20-30, poultry about 0.1-0.15 kg per head per day, varying with body weight and feed.
map.粪含水约 75%~85%，干物质率=1−含水率。: Manure is about 75%-85% water, so dry matter rate = 1 − water content.
map.→ 打开粪便处理量估算器工具: → Open the Manure Amount (free · browser-only · no data uploads)
map.本工具纯前端运行，输入内容不上传服务器；结果为按上述口径得到的理论估算值。实际应: This tool runs entirely in the browser and does not upload inputs. Results are theoretical estimates using the method above. Actual use depends on equipment parameters, measurement conditions and local standards; refer to equipment nameplates, test reports and current standards, and consult professionals for major decisions.
